versions.changelog:
No code changes detected.  
SKILL.md was revised with minor description and wording improvements.

- Improved the skill name and intro for clarity in the description.
- Expanded trigger keywords in the description to highlight coverage of popular Chinese platforms (e.g., 淘宝, 京东, 美团, 支付宝, 等).
- Enhanced trigger phrase listing for spending and reporting.
- Skill functionality and structure remain unchanged.

- Chart generation now outputs PNG images instead of SVG, and responses will prioritize sending images as attachments.
- Chart script API updated: use `png_markdown`, `png_data_uri`, or `png_path` for image output.
- Data model version downgraded from 2.1 to 2.0, removing USD conversion fields.
- Report aggregation and chart currency display are now consistently based on `default_currency`, with missing exchange rates triggering warnings.
- Documentation streamlined with a focus on key commands and clearer usage instructions.

- Added scripts/charts.py to enable visualization of expense data.
- Now supports generating and sending SVG charts: pie, bar, and trend line charts.
- Updated documentation with chart commands and chart storage locations.
- All charts can be requested using natural-language commands and are sent directly in chat.

**Major update: New bilingual & multi-currency version with advanced expense parsing and reporting.**

- Fully redesigned for Chinese & English support, with all confirmations and reports matching user language.
- Replaces previous script interface with smart text triggers: auto-detect and record any expense, batch entry, or report/export/budget query from natural language.
- Category system updated and localized; uses detailed keywords for automatic classification.
- Data model now supports accounts, currencies, exchange rates, member tags, and richer entry details (JSON-based).
- Added script interfaces: `scripts/ledger.py` (core) and `scripts/export.py` (export to CSV/Excel/JSON); legacy `log_expense.py` removed.
- Multi-currency support: recognizes CNY, USD, EUR, and shows dual-currency summaries; exchange rates configurable via conversation.
- Comprehensive sample prompts, confirmations, and report output formats for both languages provided.
